data: Tom (François Goeske) tritt in seinem Heimatort auf wie ein Fremder. Er trägt immer schwarz, hört melancholische Musik und kann mit den Menschen um ihn herum nicht viel anfangen. Seine Mutter starb vor einigen Jahren und mit seinem Vater (Wotan Wilke Möhring) hat er sich nicht mehr viel zu sagen. Nur zu seiner Oma Wally (Hannelore Elsner) und seinem Sandkastenfreund Mike (Jannis Niewöhner) hat er noch einen guten Draht. Im Gegensatz zu seinem besten Kumpel ist Tom völlig planlos. Er ist durch das Abitur gefallen und weiß nun nicht, wie es weitergehen soll. Die Berufsberaterin empfiehlt ihm einen Job als Bestattungsfachkraft. Tatsächlich kommt Tom mit seinem neuen Beruf und den netten Kollegen gut klar. Schließlich lernt er auch noch Sarah (Anna Fischer) kennen, die nach aufregenden Studentenjahren in Berlin an ihren Heimatort zurückgekehrt ist und sich dort genauso wie Tom fehl am Platz fühlt. Die beiden passen offenbar gut zusammen – doch dann stirbt Mike, völlig unerwartet – und Tom droht erneut den Boden unter den Füßen zu verlieren… (Young Tom has always been an eccentric. He is constantly dressed in black, preferably listens to gloomy music and has nothing in common with most of the people in his small hometown. He has been even more reclusive since his mother passed away, and the relationship to his estranged father is characterized by utter silence. The only people close to him are his grandmother Wally and his childhood friend Mike. But unlike Mike, Tom has no goals: He has just dropped out of school, and has no idea what to do with himself. However; a career counselor procures him a job in a funeral home. After some adjustment problems, Tom eventually starts to enjoy the unusual work for which proves to be perfectly suited. Moreover, he strikes up a friendship with the congenial Sarah. But then an unexpected blow of fate threatens to demoralize Tom.)

Young Tom has always been an eccentric. He is constantly dressed in black, preferably listens to gloomy music and has nothing in common with most of the people in his small hometown. He has been even more reclusive since his mother passed away, and the relationship to his estranged father is characterized by utter silence. The only people close to him are his grandmother Wally and his childhood friend Mike. But unlike Mike, Tom has no goals: He has just dropped out of school, and has no idea what to do with himself. However; a career counselor procures him a job in a funeral home. After some adjustment problems, Tom eventually starts to enjoy the unusual work for which proves to be perfectly suited. Moreover, he strikes up a friendship with the congenial Sarah. But then an unexpected blow of fate threatens to demoralize Tom.
